name: WebRTC Video Client
description: Receives live H.264 video via standard WHEP (mediamtx, go2rtc, LiveKit, Cloudflare Stream...) and feeds each stream to PlotJuggler as canonical PJ.VideoFrame messages. One HTTP request per stream, per-camera reconnect, mediamtx Control API discovery. H.264 pass-through; no transcode.
author: PlotJuggler Team
